description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different model types during Whisper fine-tuning, with the model type set to 'tiny'. The x-axis is labeled "epoch", is linear, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "WER", is linear, ranges from 20 to 70, and has tick labels at intervals of 10.  The line representing 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' is black with circular markers, starting at approximately 68 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 32 at epoch 6. The line representing 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' is gray with square markers, beginning at approximately 61 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 37 at epoch 6. The line representing 'tiny int4' is light gray with triangular markers, starting at approximately 54 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 39 at epoch 6. The line representing 'tiny int8' is dark gray with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 47 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 35 at epoch 6. Finally, the line representing 'tiny full' is dotted and black, starting at approximately 28 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 25 at epoch 6.
